		i32.const 2

		i32.const -333 ;;omitted
		call $svb
		
		i32.const 0
		local.get $str...anibind
		call $sbg
		
		i32.const 0 local.set $i
		(loop $lp
			local.get $str...indr
					local.get $i
					local.get $indoff
				i32.add
				i32.const 20
			i32.mul
			call $di
			
				local.get $i
				i32.const 1
			i32.add
			
				local.tee $i
				local.get $bonelen
			i32.lt_s
			br_if $lp
		)
	)
